text:
dana_cs: Hey team — onboarding run for SignalTrail is failing during SDK init. They get a 403 at /v1/embed and the log shows header mismatch + rate limiter tagging by client header. Copy of log below.

alex_devex: can you paste the exact curl or SDK call they used?

dana_cs: Sure — they used our node starter snippet from docs: 
```
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.embed.create({ model: 'embed-lite', input: 'foo' });
```
From logs: 403 Forbidden - reason: "auth.scope_mismatch" and note: "limiter=client:edge-starter/1.2.3"

taylor_se: 2 quick leads: (1) token scope may be workspace-scoped not project-scoped (scope mismatch) and (2) our rate limiter tags by the x-client header which can cause per-client buckets if proxy sends it upstream. Did they route through a gateway that rewrites headers?

SignalTrail rep (via email): We run the starter in Cloudflare Workers and then fan requests to our backend which forwards to Redwood. We only see 403s during warmup bursts.

alex_devex: That explains it. Cloudflare sometimes strips/normalizes certain headers and can also reuse IPs — our limiter has two axes: token-based and client-tag. If the forwarded requests all present the same x-client but different tokens (or stale tokens), it might hit the client-tag bucket.

dana_cs: Is there a recommended quick workaround we can give them so they can proceed with onboarding?

alex_devex: Yes — two safe steps to try immediately: 
1) Ensure the SDK is sending Authorization: Bearer <token> from the fresh onboarding token (not a user token). Confirm token payload has project scope via `jwt.io` or our token-introspect endpoint.
2) Temporarily disable client-tagging for their account while they ramp. I can flip a flag on the account level that forces limiter to use token id only. That avoids accidental cross-client buckets.

taylor_se: Also suggest adding jitter and exponential backoff in their warmup loop. For serverless warmups, a tight fan of concurrent connections looks like a stampede. Use a small random delay 50-300ms between connections.

deploy-bot: Account flag change queued: account_id=acct_01GZ queued action=disable_client_tagging by=alex_devex. ETA: 2m.

dana_cs: Awesome. I told SignalTrail we can toggle the flag and asked them to confirm they rotated to the onboarding token. They said they will try the token rotation now and will hold warmup until we toggle.

alex_devex: Done — flag flipped. On our side the limiter will only look at token_id for 10 minutes while they ramp. Keep me posted on any 403 -> 429 flip.

SignalTrail rep (via email forwarded by dana_cs): After token rotation and pause of warmup, 403s stopped. We saw a few 429s when we resumed warmup without jitter — we advised them to add exponential backoff and to split warmup into staggered waves.

dana_cs: Closing loop: onboarding resumed, no more 403s, small 429 blips during aggressive warmup which we mitigated with jitter advice. Action items:
- alex_devex: leave client_tagging disabled for 10m then auto-reinstate.
- taylor_se: add one-liner to onboarding checklist about token scope verification + warmup pacing.
- dana_cs: follow up with SignalTrail in 24h for renewal health check.

alex_devex: noted.

taylor_se: on it, will add checklist entry and a short snippet for backoff.

dana_cs: Thanks all! :shipit:
